HELP_TEXT.TITLE: How to use the Slack Integration?
HELP_TEXT.BODY:
With this integration, all of your incoming conversations will be synced to the ***{selectedChannelName}*** channel in your Slack workspace. You can manage all your customer conversations right within the channel and never miss a message.

Here are the main features of the integration:

**Respond to conversations from within Slack:** To respond to a conversation in the ***{selectedChannelName}*** Slack channel, simply type out your message and send it as a thread. This will create a response back to the customer through Shopiz. It's that simple!

 **Create private notes:** If you want to create private notes instead of replies, start your message with ***`note:`***. This ensures that your message is kept private and won't be visible to the customer.

**Associate an agent profile:** If the person who replied on Slack has an agent profile in Shopiz under the same email, the replies will be associated with that agent profile automatically. This means you can easily track who said what and when. On the other hand, when the replier doesn't have an associated agent profile, the replies will appear from the bot profile to the customer.

SELECT_CHANNEL.DESCRIPTION:
Your Slack workspace is now linked with Shopiz. However, the integration is currently inactive. To activate the integration and connect a channel to Shopiz, please click the button below.

**Note:** If you are attempting to connect a private channel, add the Shopiz app to the Slack channel before proceeding with this step.
SELECT_CHANNEL.EXPIRED: Your Slack integration has expired. To continue receiving messages on Slack, please delete the integration and connect your workspace again.

DASHBOARD_APPS.TITLE: Dashboard Apps
DASHBOARD_APPS.SIDEBAR_TXT:
Dashboard Apps

Dashboard Apps allow organizations to embed an application inside the Shopiz dashboard to provide the context for customer support agents. This feature allows you to create an application independently and embed that inside the dashboard to provide user information, their orders, or their previous payment history.

When you embed your application using the dashboard in Shopiz, your application will get the context of the conversation and contact as a window event. Implement a listener for the message event on your page to receive the context.

To add a new dashboard app, click on the button 'Add a new dashboard app'.

SCENARIOS.TITLE: Scenarios
SCENARIOS.DESCRIPTION: Give your assistant some context - like “what to do when a user is stuck,” or “how to act during a refund request.”

CASE_STUDIES.name: General Consultation Pack
CASE_STUDIES.description: Basic consultation scenarios, capturing leads and requesting phone numbers for further support.

scenarios.title: Basic Consultation & Lead Generation
scenarios.description: Classification: Consultation & Lead Capture. Use this scenario when a customer initiates contact with general questions and the goal is to provide basic answers and collect their phone number for Zalo support.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Consult and answer queries using [search_documentation](tool://search_documentation) (FAQ), [search_canned_responses](tool://search_canned_responses), or [execute_macro](tool://execute_macro).
Step 2: Politely ask for their phone number.
Step 3: Once provided, use [update_customer](tool://update_customer) to save it.
Step 4: Propose to connect on Zalo. Use [send_zalo_friend_request](tool://send_zalo_friend_request) to send a friend request with a greeting.
Step 5: Use [update_conversation_tags](tool://update_conversation_tags) to tag the conversation.

CASE_STUDIES.name: E-commerce Support Complete Pack
CASE_STUDIES.description: A complete set of scenarios for e-commerce platforms to handle FAQs, order tracking, returns, and complaints.

scenarios.title: Sales Assistant & General FAQ
scenarios.description: Classification: E-commerce General FAQ. Use this scenario when customers have general questions about products, store policies (shipping, payment, hours) that are NOT related to a specific order.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Greet the customer and clarify their question.
Step 2: Use [search_documentation](tool://search_documentation) and [search_articles](tool://search_articles) to find relevant policy or product information.
Step 3: Answer the customer concisely and enthusiastically based on the findings.
Step 4: If information is missing or the request is too complex, use [execute_macro](tool://execute_macro) to handoff to a human agent.

scenarios.title: Order Tracking
scenarios.description: Classification: Order Tracking. Use this scenario when customers want to know the status, location, or delivery time of a specific order they placed.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Greet the customer and request their Order ID or phone number if not already provided.
Step 2: Use [search_orders](tool://search_orders) to look up the order based on provided info.
Step 3: Use [get_order_detail](tool://get_order_detail) to fetch the detailed status and latest updates.
Step 4: Reply with clear, updated information and ask if they need further assistance.

scenarios.title: Returns and Refunds
scenarios.description: Classification: Returns & Refunds. Use this scenario when customers request a refund, return, or exchange for a purchased item due to defect or dissatisfaction.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Listen and identify the reason for the return/refund request. Ask for photos/videos if necessary.
Step 2: Evaluate if the request is valid according to the return policy.
Step 3: If valid, guide them through the return process and use [execute_macro](tool://execute_macro) to create a return ticket.

scenarios.title: Escalation and Handoff
scenarios.description: Classification: Complaint/Agent Handoff. Use this scenario when customers express anger, dissatisfaction, or explicitly ask to speak with a human agent or manager.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Identify the customer's sentiment. If negative, immediately apologize and try to de-escalate.
Step 2: Do not attempt to resolve complex disputes on your own.
Step 3: Immediately use [execute_macro](tool://execute_macro) to transfer the conversation to a human customer care agent.

CASE_STUDIES.name: Spa & Beauty Support Pack
CASE_STUDIES.description: Scenarios tailored for spas and beauty salons to handle bookings, service queries, and scheduling.

scenarios.title: Spa Appointment Booking
scenarios.description: Classification: Spa Booking. Use this scenario when clients want to book an appointment or check available time slots for spa/clinic services.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Ask the client for details on the desired service, preferred date, and time.
Step 2: Use [get_available_times](tool://get_available_times) to find available slots matching their request.
Step 3: Propose the available times for them to choose.
Step 4: Once chosen, use [book_appointment](tool://book_appointment) to confirm the booking.

scenarios.title: Services & Pricing FAQ
scenarios.description: Classification: Spa Services Consulting. Use this scenario when clients ask about available treatments, their benefits, duration, and pricing.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Identify the specific service the client is interested in.
Step 2: Use [search_articles](tool://search_articles) to look up accurate information on treatments, duration, and prices.
Step 3: Provide clear, appealing advice and the exact price to the client.

scenarios.title: Cancel or Reschedule Appointment
scenarios.description: Classification: Appointment Management. Use this scenario when clients want to change (reschedule) or cancel an existing appointment.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Ask for the appointment ID or the phone number used for the booking.
Step 2: Confirm whether they want to cancel or reschedule to a new date/time.
Step 3: Use [manage_booking](tool://manage_booking) to process the cancellation or rescheduling in the system.
Step 4: Notify the client of the successful update.

CASE_STUDIES.name: EdTech & Education Support Pack
CASE_STUDIES.description: Scenarios for online learning platforms and language centers to handle course enrollments and student support.

scenarios.title: Course Advisor & Recommendation
scenarios.description: Classification: Course Advising. Use this scenario when students or parents seek advice on choosing a course that fits their current level and goals.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Ask about their learning goals (e.g., IELTS, communication, kids) and current proficiency level.
Step 2: Analyze their needs.
Step 3: Use [search_articles](tool://search_articles) to find and suggest the most suitable courses.
Step 4: Outline the basic learning path and benefits of the course.

scenarios.title: Class Schedule Lookup
scenarios.description: Classification: Schedule Lookup. Use this scenario when students want to check their upcoming timetable, class schedule, teachers, or room assignments.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Request the student's ID or registered phone number.
Step 2: Use [search_canned_responses](tool://search_canned_responses) to find standard replies or directly provide the schedule information.
Step 3: Guide the student on how to check the portal themselves in the future (if applicable).

scenarios.title: Leave Request & Pause Course
scenarios.description: Classification: Student Admin Request. Use this scenario when a student needs to take a temporary leave of absence, pause their course, or report an absence.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Ask for the reason and expected duration of the leave (from which date to which date).
Step 2: Briefly explain the leave/pause policy if necessary.
Step 3: Use [execute_macro](tool://execute_macro) to submit the leave request to the admin/management team for processing.

CASE_STUDIES.name: Real Estate & Agency Pack
CASE_STUDIES.description: Scenarios for real estate agents to handle property inquiries and viewings.

scenarios.title: Property Search & Matching
scenarios.description: Classification: Property Search. Use this scenario when clients are looking to buy or rent a property and want to know what options are available.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Gather client requirements: desired location, budget, number of bedrooms, etc.
Step 2: Use [search_articles](tool://search_articles) to search the database for properties/projects matching the criteria.
Step 3: Suggest a few top options with basic info and photos.

scenarios.title: Book Property Viewing
scenarios.description: Classification: Property Viewing Booking. Use this scenario when a client is interested in a specific property/project and wants to schedule an in-person viewing.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Confirm the exact property ID or project the client wants to visit.
Step 2: Ask for their preferred date and time for the viewing.
Step 3: Use [book_appointment](tool://book_appointment) to schedule the viewing with an agent and send a confirmation to the client.

scenarios.title: Neighborhood & Amenities FAQ
scenarios.description: Classification: Neighborhood Info. Use this scenario when clients ask about the living environment, internal/external amenities (schools, supermarkets, parking) of a project.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Identify the project the client is referring to.
Step 2: Use [search_documentation](tool://search_documentation) to retrieve details about nearby amenities (supermarkets, schools, hospitals, parking...).
Step 3: Reply in detail to highlight the value of the location.

CASE_STUDIES.name: Travel & Tourism Pack
CASE_STUDIES.description: Scenarios for travel agencies and tour operators to handle bookings and travel inquiries.

scenarios.title: Tour & Ticket Booking
scenarios.description: Classification: Travel Booking. Use this scenario when customers want to finalize a booking for tours, flights, hotels, or attraction tickets.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Collect full details: departure date, return date, destination, number of pax (adults/children).
Step 2: Provide an initial quote (if available).
Step 3: Use [book_appointment](tool://book_appointment) to log the booking request or schedule a callback for detailed support.

scenarios.title: Itinerary Suggestion
scenarios.description: Classification: Itinerary Consulting. Use this scenario when customers plan to travel but are unsure where to go, or need a detailed itinerary suggestion.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Ask about their preferences (relaxation vs. exploration), estimated budget, and trip duration.
Step 2: Use [search_articles](tool://search_articles) to find matching articles or sample itineraries.
Step 3: Propose an appealing basic itinerary highlighting key destinations.

scenarios.title: Travel FAQ & Policies
scenarios.description: Classification: Travel Regulations. Use this scenario when customers ask about paperwork, visas, airline luggage rules, or cancellation policies.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Listen carefully to the customer's question regarding procedures/rules.
Step 2: Use [search_documentation](tool://search_documentation) to look up accurate information from trusted sources (airlines, embassies).
Step 3: Provide a clear answer, noting important details so the customer avoids documentation issues.

CASE_STUDIES.name: Digital Electronics & Tech Retail Pack
CASE_STUDIES.description: Scenarios for electronics retailers selling computers, smartphones, and gadgets.

scenarios.title: Tech Product Advisor
scenarios.description: Classification: Tech Consulting. Use this scenario when customers need advice on buying a computer, phone, or gadget that fits their needs and budget.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Ask the customer about their budget and primary use case (gaming, office, graphic design...).
Step 2: Use [suggest_products](tool://suggest_products) or [search_products](tool://search_products) to find the most suitable models.
Step 3: Recommend the top 2-3 options and gently compare pros and cons to help them decide.

scenarios.title: Warranty & Repair Check
scenarios.description: Classification: Warranty & Repair. Use this scenario when customers need to check their device's warranty status or the repair progress of a device at the store.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Request the product's serial number (IMEI) or the purchase phone number/repair ticket number.
Step 2: Use [search_orders](tool://search_orders) or [get_order_detail](tool://get_order_detail) to look up the info in the system.
Step 3: Inform the customer of the current warranty status or repair progress.

scenarios.title: Basic Technical Support
scenarios.description: Classification: Tech Troubleshooting. Use this scenario when customers encounter basic software glitches (freezes, wifi issues) and need remote troubleshooting.
scenarios.instruction:
Step 1: Ask the customer to describe the issue in detail or send a screenshot if possible.
Step 2: Use [search_documentation](tool://search_documentation) to find corresponding troubleshooting guides.
Step 3: Guide the customer step-by-step (1, 2, 3...) to fix the issue themselves.
